facts.fact: IDinsight states that KHIS Aggregate is used by the Ministry of Health to collect, manage and analyse health data from facilities nationwide, and that the ministry's Health Informatics Division creates and revises the registers and forms that feed it; no date is given, so the document's publication date is used.

IDinsight states that KHIS Aggregate collects data from health facilities nationwide and is designed to support health information management at all levels of the health system, from the national level down to the community level; it names no facility tier individually and gives no date, so the document's publication date is used.

IDinsight states that KHIS Aggregate is web-based and lets health facilities enter and submit their data online, and that facilities record services in paper daily activity registers which are summarised at the end of the week or month and entered into KHIS; no date is given, so the document's publication date is used.

IDinsight reports that Kenyatta National Hospital told its interviewers it has an e-hospital platform used mainly to capture clinical data; no date is given, so the document's publication date is used.
